segments.vism23:854.1: Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ ‘‘paññābhāvanāya ko ānisaṃso’’ti, tattha vadāma.
segments.vism23:854.3: Tassā dīghenāpi addhunā na sukaraṃ vitthārato ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsetuṃ.
segments.vism23:854.4: Saṅkhepato panassā nānākilesaviddhaṃsanaṃ, ariyaphalarasānubhavanaṃ, nirodhasamāpattisamāpajjanasamatthatā, āhuneyyabhāvādisiddhīti ayamānisaṃso veditabbo.
segments.vism23:855.1: Tattha yaṃ nāmarūpaparicchedato paṭṭhāya sakkāyadiṭṭhādīnaṃ vasena nānākilesaviddhaṃsanaṃ vuttaṃ, ayaṃ lokikāya paññābhāvanāya ānisaṃso.
segments.vism23:855.2: Yaṃ ariyamaggakkhaṇe saṃyojanādīnaṃ vasena nānākilesaviddhaṃsanaṃ vuttaṃ, ayaṃ lokuttarāya paññābhāvanāya ānisaṃsoti veditabbo.
segments.vism23:856.1: Ariyaphalarasānubhavananti na kevalañca kilesaviddhaṃsanaññeva, ariyaphalarasānubhavanampi paññābhāvanāya ānisaṃso.
segments.vism23:857.1: Apica ye ‘‘saṃyojanappahānamattameva phalaṃ nāma, na koci añño dhammo atthī’’ti vadanti, tesaṃ anunayatthaṃ idaṃ suttampi dassetabbaṃ – ‘‘kathaṃ payogapaṭippassaddhipaññā phale ñāṇaṃ?
segments.vism23:857.2: Sotāpattimaggakkhaṇe dassanaṭṭhena sammādiṭṭhi micchādiṭṭhiyā vuṭṭhāti, tadanuvattakakilesehi ca khandhehi ca vuṭṭhāti, bahiddhā ca sabbanimittehi vuṭṭhāti.
segments.vism23:857.3: Tampayogapaṭippassaddhattā uppajjati sammādiṭṭhi, maggassetaṃ phala’’nti (paṭi. ma. 1.63) vitthāretabbaṃ.
segments.vism23:857.4: ‘‘Cattāro maggā apariyāpannā, cattāri ca sāmaññaphalāni, ime dhammā appamāṇārammaṇā’’ (dha. sa. 1422). ‘‘Mahaggato dhammo appamāṇassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo’’ti (paṭṭhā. 2.12.62) evamādīnipi cettha sādhakāni.
segments.vism23:858.1: Phalasamāpattiyaṃ pavattidassanatthaṃ panassa idaṃ pañhākammaṃ – kā phalasamāpatti, ke taṃ samāpajjanti, ke na samāpajjanti, kasmā samāpajjanti, kathañcassā samāpajjanaṃ hoti, kathaṃ ṭhānaṃ, kathaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ, kiṃ phalassa anantaraṃ, kassa ca phalaṃ anantaranti?
segments.vism23:859.1: Tattha kā phalasamāpattīti yā ariyaphalassa nirodhe appanā.
segments.vism23:860.1: Ke taṃ samāpajjanti, ke na samāpajjantīti sabbepi puthujjanā na samāpajjanti.
segments.vism23:860.7: Uparimā pana heṭṭhimaṃ na samāpajjanti, puggalantarabhāvupagamanena paṭippassaddhattā.
segments.vism23:860.9: Attano attanoyeva pana phalaṃ samāpajjantīti idamettha sanniṭṭhānaṃ.
segments.vism23:860.12: Idañca tesaṃ kāraṇaṃ, ete hi samādhismiṃ paripūrakārinoti.
segments.vism23:860.15: Nanu pāḷiyaṃyeva vuttaṃ – ‘‘katame dasa gotrabhudhammā vipassanāvasena uppajjanti?
segments.vism23:860.16: Sotāpattimaggapaṭilābhatthāya uppādaṃ pavattaṃ…pe… upāyāsaṃ bahiddhā saṅkhāranimittaṃ abhibhuyyatīti gotrabhu.
segments.vism23:860.17: Sotāpattiphalasamāpattatthāya sakadāgāmimaggaṃ …pe… arahattaphalasamāpattatthāya… suññatavihārasamāpattatthāya… animittavihārasamāpattatthāya uppādaṃ…pe… bahiddhā saṅkhāranimittaṃ abhibhuyyatīti gotrabhū’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.60).
segments.vism23:860.18: Tasmā sabbepi ariyā attano attano phalaṃ samāpajjantīti niṭṭhamettha gantabbaṃ.
segments.vism23:861.2: Yathā hi rājā rajjasukhaṃ, devatā dibbasukhaṃ anubhavanti, evaṃ ariyā ‘‘ariyaṃ lokuttarasukhaṃ anubhavissāmā’’ti addhānapparicchedaṃ katvā icchiticchitakkhaṇe phalasamāpattiṃ samāpajjanti.
segments.vism23:862.1: Kathañcassā samāpajjanaṃ hoti, kathaṃ ṭhānaṃ, kathaṃ vuṭṭhānanti dvīhi tāva ākārehi assā samāpajjanaṃ hoti – nibbānato aññassa ārammaṇassa amanasikārā nibbānassa ca manasikārā.
segments.vism23:862.2: Yathāha – ‘‘dve kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā sabbanimittānañca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro’’ti (ma. ni. 1.458).
segments.vism23:863.2: Phalasamāpattatthikena hi ariyasāvakena rahogatena paṭisallīnena udayabbayādivasena saṅkhārā vipassitabbā.
segments.vism23:863.3: Tassa pavattānupubbavipassanassa saṅkhārārammaṇagotrabhuñāṇānantarā phalasamāpattivasena nirodhe cittaṃ appeti.
segments.vism23:863.4: Phalasamāpattininnatāya cettha sekkhassāpi phalameva uppajjati, na maggo.
segments.vism23:863.5: Ye pana vadanti ‘‘sotāpanno ‘phalasamāpattiṃ samāpajjissāmī’ti vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā sakadāgāmī hoti.
segments.vism23:863.6: Sakadāgāmī ca anāgāmī’’ti, te vattabbā ‘‘evaṃ sati anāgāmī arahā bhavissati, arahā paccekabuddho, paccekabuddho ca buddho.
segments.vism23:863.7: Tasmā na kiñci etaṃ, pāḷivaseneva ca paṭikkhitta’’ntipi na gahetabbaṃ.
segments.vism23:863.8: Idameva pana gahetabbaṃ – sekkhassāpi phalameva uppajjati, na maggo.
segments.vism23:863.9: Phalañcassa sace anena paṭhamajjhāniko maggo adhigato hoti.
segments.vism23:864.1: ‘‘Tayo kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā ṭhitiyā sabbanimittānañca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro, pubbe ca abhisaṅkhāro’’ti (ma. ni. 1.458) vacanato panassā tīhākārehi ṭhānaṃ hoti.
segments.vism23:864.2: Tattha pubbe ca abhisaṅkhāroti samāpattito pubbe kālaparicchedo. ‘‘Asukasmiṃ nāma kāle vuṭṭhahissāmī’’ti paricchinnattā hissā yāva so kālo nāgacchati, tāva ṭhānaṃ hoti.
segments.vism23:865.1: ‘‘Dve kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā vuṭṭhānāya sabbanimittānañca manasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā amanasikāro’’ti (ma. ni. 1.458) vacanato panassā dvīhākārehi vuṭṭhānaṃ hoti.
segments.vism23:865.3: Kāmañca na sabbānevetāni ekato manasikaroti sabbasaṅgāhikavasena panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.vism23:865.4: Tasmā yaṃ bhavaṅgassa ārammaṇaṃ hoti, taṃ manasikaroto phalasamāpattivuṭṭhānaṃ hotīti evamassā vuṭṭhānaṃ veditabbaṃ.
segments.vism23:866.1: Kiṃ phalassa anantaraṃ, kassa ca phalaṃ anantaranti phalassa tāva phalameva vā anantaraṃ hoti, bhavaṅgaṃ vā.
segments.vism23:866.2: Phalaṃ pana atthi maggānantaraṃ, atthi phalānantaraṃ, atthi gotrabhuanantaraṃ, atthi nevasaññānāsaññāyatanānantaraṃ.
segments.vism23:866.3: Tattha maggavīthiyaṃ maggānantaraṃ, purimassa purimassa pacchimaṃ pacchimaṃ phalānantaraṃ.
segments.vism23:866.6: Vuttañhetaṃ paṭṭhāne – ‘‘arahato anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo.
segments.vism23:866.8: Yena phalena nirodhā vuṭṭhānaṃ hoti, taṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanānantaranti.
segments.vism23:866.9: Tattha ṭhapetvā maggavīthiyaṃ uppannaṃ phalaṃ avasesaṃ sabbaṃ phalasamāpattivasena pavattaṃ nāma.
segments.vism23:866.16: Phalassa paññaṃ bhāvetvā, yasmā vindati paṇḍito.
segments.vism23:867.1: Nirodhasamāpattisamāpajjanasamatthatāti na kevalañca ariyaphalarasānubhavanaṃyeva, ayaṃ pana nirodhasamāpattiyā samāpajjanasamatthatāpi imissā paññābhāvanāya ānisaṃsoti veditabbo.
segments.vism23:867.2: Tatridaṃ nirodhasamāpattiyā vibhāvanatthaṃ pañhākammaṃ – kā nirodhasamāpatti, ke taṃ samāpajjanti, ke na samāpajjanti, kattha samāpajjanti, kasmā samāpajjanti, kathañcassā samāpajjanaṃ hoti, kathaṃ ṭhānaṃ, kathaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ, vuṭṭhitassa kiṃninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, matassa ca samāpannassa ca ko viseso, nirodhasamāpatti kiṃ saṅkhatā asaṅkhatā lokiyā lokuttarā nipphannā anipphannāti?
segments.vism23:868.1: Tattha kā nirodhasamāpattīti yā anupubbanirodhavasena cittacetasikānaṃ dhammānaṃ appavatti.
segments.vism23:868.2: Ke taṃ samāpajjanti, ke na samāpajjantīti sabbepi puthujjanā, sotāpannā, sakadāgāmino, sukkhavipassakā ca anāgāmino, arahanto na samāpajjanti.
segments.vism23:868.3: Aṭṭhasamāpattilābhino pana anāgāmino, khīṇāsavā ca samāpajjanti. ‘‘Dvīhi balehi samannāgatattā, tayo ca saṅkhārānaṃ paṭippassaddhiyā, soḷasahi ñāṇacariyāhi, navahi samādhicariyāhi vasībhāvatā paññā nirodhasamāpattiyā ñāṇa’’nti (paṭi. ma. mātikā 1.34) hi vuttaṃ.
segments.vism23:868.4: Ayañca sampadā ṭhapetvā aṭṭhasamāpattilābhino anāgāmikhīṇāsave aññesaṃ natthi.
segments.vism23:869.1: Katamāni panettha dve balāni…pe… katamā vasībhāvatāti?
segments.vism23:869.2: Na ettha kiñci amhehi vattabbaṃ atthi.
segments.vism23:869.8: Abyāpādavasena… ālokasaññāvasena… avikkhepavasena…pe… paṭinissaggānupassiassāsavasena… paṭinissaggānupassipassāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samathabalanti.
segments.vism23:869.11: Dutiyajjhānena vitakkavicāre…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā ākiñcaññāyatanasaññāya na kampatīti samathabalaṃ.
segments.vism23:869.12: Uddhacce ca uddhaccasahagatakilese ca khandhe ca na kampati na calati na vedhatīti samathabalaṃ.
segments.vism23:869.16: Dukkhānupassanā… anattānupassanā… nibbidānupassanā… virāgānupassanā… nirodhānupassanā… paṭinissaggānupassanā vipassanābalaṃ.
segments.vism23:869.18: Vedanāya… saññāya… saṅkhāresu… viññāṇe… cakkhusmiṃ…pe… jarāmaraṇe aniccānupassanā.
segments.vism23:869.22: Dukkhānupassanāya sukhasaññāya na kampatīti… anattānupassanāya attasaññāya na kampatīti… nibbidānupassanāya nandiyā na kampatīti… virāgānupassanāya rāge na kampatīti… nirodhānupassanāya samudaye na kampatīti… paṭinissaggānupassanāya ādāne na kampatīti vipassanābalaṃ.
segments.vism23:869.23: Avijjāya ca avijjāsahagatakilese ca khandhe ca na kampati na calati na vedhatīti vipassanābalaṃ.
segments.vism23:869.25: ‘‘Tayo ca saṅkhārānaṃ paṭippassaddhiyāti katamesaṃ tiṇṇannaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ paṭippassaddhiyā?
segments.vism23:869.26: Dutiyajjhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhārā paṭippassaddhā honti.
segments.vism23:869.27: Catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā kāyasaṅkhārā paṭippassaddhā honti.
segments.vism23:869.28: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhārā paṭippassaddhā honti.
segments.vism23:869.32: Dukkhā… anattā… nibbidā… virāgā… nirodhā… paṭinissaggā… vivaṭṭānupassanā ñāṇacariyā.
segments.vism23:869.40: Paṭhamajjhānapaṭilābhatthāya vitakko ca vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiṃ paṭilābhatthāya vitakko ca vicāro ca pīti ca sukhañca cittekaggatā ca.
segments.vism23:869.42: ‘‘Vasīti pañca vasiyo – āvajjanavasī, samāpajjanavasī, adhiṭṭhānavasī, vuṭṭhānavasī, paccavekkhaṇavasī.
segments.vism23:869.43: Paṭhamajjhānaṃ yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvaticchakaṃ āvajjati, āvajjanāya dandhāyitattaṃ natthīti āvajjanavasī.
segments.vism23:869.44: Paṭhamajjhānaṃ yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvaticchakaṃ samāpajjati, samāpajjanāya dandhāyitattaṃ natthīti samāpajjanavasī…pe… adhiṭṭhāti adhiṭṭhāne…pe… vuṭṭhāti vuṭṭhāne…pe… paccavekkhati paccavekkhaṇāya dandhāyitattaṃ natthīti paccavekkhaṇavasī.
segments.vism23:869.45: Dutiyaṃ…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiṃ yatthicchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvaticchakaṃ āvajjati …pe… paccavekkhati.
segments.vism23:870.3: Yadi evaṃ sakadāgāmino dvādasahi sotāpannassa ca dasahi kiṃ na hotīti?
segments.vism23:870.4: Na hoti, samādhipāribandhikassa pañca kāmaguṇikarāgassa appahīnattā.
segments.vism23:870.6: Tasmā samathabalaṃ na paripuṇṇaṃ hoti, tasmiṃ aparipūre dvīhi balehi samāpajjitabbaṃ nirodhasamāpattiṃ balavekallena samāpajjituṃ na sakkonti.
segments.vism23:870.7: Anāgāmissa pana so pahīno, tasmā esa paripuṇṇabalo hoti.
segments.vism23:870.9: Tenāha bhagavā – ‘‘nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakusalaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo’’ti (paṭṭhā. 1.1.417).
segments.vism23:870.10: Idañhi paṭṭhāne mahāpakaraṇe anāgāminova nirodhā vuṭṭhānaṃ sandhāya vuttanti.
segments.vism23:872.1: Kasmā samāpajjantīti saṅkhārānaṃ pavattibhede ukkaṇṭhitvā diṭṭheva dhamme acittakā hutvā ‘‘nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ patvā sukhaṃ viharissāmā’’ti samāpajjanti.
segments.vism23:873.1: Kathañcassā samāpajjanaṃ hotīti samathavipassanāvasena ussakkitvā katapubbakiccassa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ nirodhayato, evamassa samāpajjanaṃ hoti.
segments.vism23:873.2: Yo hi samathavaseneva ussakkati, so nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiṃ patvā tiṭṭhati.
segments.vism23:873.3: Yo pana vipassanāvaseneva ussakkati, so phalasamāpattiṃ patvā tiṭṭhati.
segments.vism23:873.4: Yo pana ubhayavaseneva ussakkitvā pubbakiccaṃ katvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ nirodheti, so taṃ samāpajjatīti ayamettha saṅkhepo.
segments.vism23:874.1: Ayaṃ pana vitthāro – idha bhikkhu nirodhaṃ samāpajjitukāmo katabhattakicco sudhotahatthapādo vivitte okāse supaññattamhi āsane nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, so paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya tattha saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati.
segments.vism23:874.2: Vipassanā panesā tividhā hoti – saṅkhāraparigaṇhanakavipassanā, phalasamāpattivipassanā, nirodhasamāpattivipassanāti.
segments.vism23:874.3: Tattha saṅkhāraparigaṇhanakavipassanā mandā vā hotu tikkhā vā, maggassa padaṭṭhānaṃ hotiyeva.
segments.vism23:874.6: Tasmā esa nātimandāya nātitikkhāya vipassanāya te saṅkhāre vipassati.
segments.vism23:874.7: Tato dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya tattha saṅkhāre tatheva vipassati.
segments.vism23:874.8: Tato tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ…pe… tato viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya tattha saṅkhāre tatheva vipassati.
segments.vism23:874.9: Tathā ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya catubbidhaṃ pubbakiccaṃ karoti – nānābaddhaavikopanaṃ, saṅghapaṭimānanaṃ, satthupakkosanaṃ, addhānaparicchedanti.
segments.vism23:875.1: Tattha nānābaddhaavikopananti yaṃ iminā bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekābaddhaṃ na hoti, nānābaddhaṃ hutvā ṭhitaṃ pattacīvaraṃ vā mañcapīṭhaṃ vā nivāsagehaṃ vā aññaṃ vā pana kiñci parikkhārajātaṃ, taṃ yathā na vikuppati, aggiudakavātacoraundūrādīnaṃ vasena na vinassati, evaṃ adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ.
segments.vism23:875.2: Tatridaṃ adhiṭṭhānavidhānaṃ ‘‘idañca idañca imasmiṃ sattāhabbhantare mā agginā jhāyatu, mā udakena vuyhatu, mā vātena viddhaṃsatu, mā corehi hariyatu, mā undūrādīhi khajjatū’’ti.
segments.vism23:875.3: Evaṃ adhiṭṭhite taṃ sattāhaṃ tassa na koci parissayo hoti.
segments.vism23:875.4: Anadhiṭṭhahato pana aggiādīhi vinassati mahānāgattherassa viya.
segments.vism23:875.5: Thero kira mātuupāsikāya gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
segments.vism23:875.8: Tasmiṃ nisinne āsanasālāya agginā gahitāya sesabhikkhū attano attano nisinnāsanaṃ gahetvā palāyiṃsu.
segments.vism23:875.10: Aggi tiṇaveṇukaṭṭhāni jhāpetvā theraṃ parikkhipitvā aṭṭhāsi.
segments.vism23:875.11: Manussā ghaṭehi udakaṃ āharitvā nibbāpetvā chārikaṃ apanetvā paribhaṇḍaṃ katvā pupphāni vikiritvā namassamānā aṭṭhaṃsu.
segments.vism23:875.12: Thero paricchinnakālavasena vuṭṭhāya te disvā ‘‘pākaṭomhi jāto’’ti vehāsaṃ uppatitvā piyaṅgudīpaṃ agamāsi.
segments.vism23:875.14: Yaṃ ekābaddhaṃ hoti nivāsanapāvuraṇaṃ vā nisinnāsanaṃ vā, tattha visuṃ adhiṭṭhānakiccaṃ natthi.
segments.vism23:875.15: Samāpattivaseneva naṃ rakkhati āyasmato sañjīvassa viya.
segments.vism23:875.16: Vuttampi cetaṃ ‘‘āyasmato sañjīvassa samādhivipphārā iddhi, āyasmato sāriputtassa samādhivipphārā iddhī’’ti.
segments.vism23:876.2: Yāva eso bhikkhu āgacchati, tāva saṅghakammassa akaraṇanti attho.
segments.vism23:876.3: Ettha ca na paṭimānanaṃ etassa pubbakiccaṃ, paṭimānanāvajjanaṃ pana pubbakiccaṃ.
segments.vism23:876.4: Tasmā evaṃ āvajjitabbaṃ ‘‘sace mayi sattāhaṃ nirodhaṃ samāpajjitvā nisinne saṅgho uttikammādīsu kiñcideva kammaṃ kattukāmo hoti, yāva maṃ koci bhikkhu āgantvā na pakkosati, tāvadeva vuṭṭhahissāmī’’ti.
segments.vism23:876.5: Evaṃ katvā samāpanno hi tasmiṃ samaye vuṭṭhātiyeva.
segments.vism23:876.6: Yo pana evaṃ na karoti, saṅgho ca sannipatitvā taṃ apassanto ‘‘asuko bhikkhu kuhi’’nti ‘‘nirodhasamāpanno’’ti vutte saṅgho kañci bhikkhuṃ peseti ‘‘gaccha naṃ saṅghassa vacanena pakkosāhī’’ti.
segments.vism23:876.7: Athassa tena bhikkhunā savanūpacāre ṭhatvā ‘‘saṅgho taṃ āvuso paṭimānetī’’ti vuttamatteva vuṭṭhānaṃ hoti.
segments.vism23:876.8: Evaṃ garukā hi saṅghassa āṇā nāma.
segments.vism23:876.9: Tasmā taṃ āvajjitvā yathā sayameva vuṭṭhāti, evaṃ samāpajjitabbaṃ.
segments.vism23:877.2: Tasmā tampi evaṃ āvajjitabbaṃ ‘‘sace mayi sattāhaṃ nirodhaṃ samāpajjitvā nisinne satthā otiṇṇavatthusmiṃ sikkhāpadaṃ vā paññapeti, tathārūpāya vā atthuppattiyā dhammaṃ deseti, yāva maṃ koci āgantvā na pakkosati, tāvadeva vuṭṭhahissāmī’’ti.
segments.vism23:877.3: Evaṃ katvā nisinno hi tasmiṃ samaye vuṭṭhātiyeva.
segments.vism23:877.4: Yo pana evaṃ na karoti, satthā ca saṅghe sannipatite taṃ apassanto ‘‘asuko bhikkhu kuhi’’nti ‘‘nirodhasamāpanno’’ti vutte kañci bhikkhuṃ peseti ‘‘gaccha naṃ mama vacanena pakkosā’’ti.
segments.vism23:877.5: Athassa tena bhikkhunā savanūpacāre ṭhatvā ‘‘satthā āyasmantaṃ āmantetī’’ti vuttamatteva vuṭṭhānaṃ hoti.
segments.vism23:877.6: Evaṃ garukaṃ hi satthupakkosanaṃ, tasmā taṃ āvajjitvā yathā sayameva vuṭṭhāti, evaṃ samāpajjitabbaṃ.
segments.vism23:878.3: Attano ‘‘āyusaṅkhārā sattāhaṃ pavattissanti na pavattissantī’’ti āvajjitvāva samāpajjitabbaṃ.
segments.vism23:878.4: Sace hi sattāhabbhantare nirujjhanake āyusaṅkhāre anāvajjitvāva samāpajjati, nāssa nirodhasamāpatti maraṇaṃ paṭibāhituṃ sakkoti.
segments.vism23:878.5: Antonirodhe maraṇassa natthitāya antarāva samāpattito vuṭṭhāti.
segments.vism23:879.1: So evaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhāya imaṃ pubbakiccaṃ katvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjati.
segments.vism23:879.2: Athekaṃ vā dve vā cittavāre atikkamitvā acittako hoti, nirodhaṃ phusati.
segments.vism23:879.3: Kasmā panassa dvinnaṃ cittānaṃ uparicittāni na pavattantīti?
segments.vism23:879.5: Idañhi imassa bhikkhuno dve samathavipassanādhamme yuganaddhe katvā aṭṭha samāpattiārohanaṃ anupubbanirodhassa payogo, na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyāti nirodhassa payogattā dvinnaṃ cittānaṃ upari na pavattanti.
segments.vism23:879.6: Yo pana bhikkhu ākiñcaññāyatanato vuṭṭhāya idaṃ pubbakiccaṃ akatvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjati, so parato acittako bhavituṃ na sakkoti, paṭinivattitvā puna ākiñcaññāyataneyeva patiṭṭhāti.
segments.vism23:879.8: Eko kira puriso ekaṃ maggaṃ agatapubbo antarā udakakandaraṃ vā gambhīraṃ udakacikkhallaṃ atikkamitvā ṭhapitaṃ caṇḍātapasantattapāsāṇaṃ vā āgamma taṃ nivāsanapāvuraṇaṃ asaṇṭhapetvāva kandaraṃ orūḷho parikkhāratemanabhayena punadeva tīre patiṭṭhāti.
segments.vism23:879.9: Pāsāṇaṃ akkamitvāpi santattapādo punadeva orabhāge patiṭṭhāti.
segments.vism23:879.10: Tattha yathā so puriso asaṇṭhapitanivāsanapāvuraṇattā kandaraṃ otiṇṇamattova, tattapāsāṇaṃ akkantamatto eva ca paṭinivattitvā oratova patiṭṭhāti, evaṃ yogāvacaropi pubbakiccassa akatattā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpannamattova paṭinivattitvā ākiñcaññāyatane patiṭṭhāti.
segments.vism23:879.11: Yathā pana pubbepi taṃ maggaṃ gatapubbapuriso taṃ ṭhānaṃ āgamma ekaṃ sāṭakaṃ daḷhaṃ nivāsetvā aparaṃ hatthena gahetvā kandaraṃ uttaritvā tattapāsāṇaṃ vā akkantamattakameva karitvā parato gacchati, evamevaṃ katapubbakicco bhikkhu nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajjitvāva parato acittako hutvā nirodhaṃ phusitvā viharati.
segments.vism23:880.1: Kathaṃ ṭhānanti evaṃ samāpannāya panassā kālaparicchedavasena ceva antarāāyukkhayasaṅghapaṭimānanasatthupakkosanābhāvena ca ṭhānaṃ hoti.
segments.vism23:881.1: Kathaṃ vuṭṭhānanti anāgāmissa anāgāmiphaluppattiyā, arahato arahattaphaluppattiyāti evaṃ dvedhā vuṭṭhānaṃ hoti.
segments.vism23:882.2: Vuttaṃ hetaṃ ‘‘saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā vuṭṭhitassa kho, āvuso visākha, bhikkhuno vivekaninnaṃ cittaṃ hoti vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāra’’nti (ma. ni. 1.464).
segments.vism23:883.1: Matassa ca samāpannassa ca ko visesoti ayampi attho sutte vuttoyeva.
segments.vism23:883.2: Yathāha – ‘‘yvāyaṃ, āvuso, mato kālaṅkato, tassa kāyasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, vacīsaṅkhārā… cittasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, āyu parikkhīṇo, usmā vūpasantā, indriyāni paribhinnāni.
segments.vism23:883.3: Yo cāyaṃ bhikkhu saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpanno, tassapi kāyasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, vacīsaṅkhārā… cittasaṅkhārā niruddhā paṭippassaddhā, āyu aparikkhīṇo, usmā avūpasantā, indriyāni aparibhinnānī’’ti (ma. ni. 1.457).
segments.vism23:884.1: Nirodhasamāpatti saṅkhatātiādipucchāyaṃ pana saṅkhatātipi asaṅkhatātipi lokiyātipi lokuttarātipi na vattabbā.
segments.vism23:884.4: Yasmā panassā samāpajjantassa vasena samāpannā nāma hoti, tasmā nipphannāti vattuṃ vaṭṭati, no anipphannā.
segments.vism23:885.1: Āhuneyyabhāvādisiddhīti na kevalañca nirodhasamāpattiyā samāpajjanasamatthatāva, ayaṃ pana āhuneyyabhāvādisiddhipi imissā lokuttarapaññābhāvanāya ānisaṃsoti veditabbo.
segments.vism23:885.2: Avisesena hi catubbidhāyapi etissā bhāvitattā bhāvitapañño puggalo sadevakassa lokassa āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalīkaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
segments.vism23:886.1: Visesato panettha paṭhamamaggapaññaṃ tāva bhāvetvā mandāya vipassanāya āgato mudindriyopi sattakkhattuparamo nāma hoti, sattasugatibhave saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
segments.vism23:886.2: Majjhimāya vipassanāya āgato majjhimindriyo kolaṃkolo nāma hoti, dve vā tīṇi vā kulāni sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
segments.vism23:886.3: Tikkhāya vipassanāya āgato tikkhindriyo ekabījī nāma hoti, ekaññeva mānusakaṃ bhavaṃ nibbattetvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
segments.vism23:887.1: Dutiyamaggapaññaṃ bhāvetvā sakadāgāmī nāma hoti, sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
segments.vism23:888.2: So indriyavemattatāvasena antarāparinibbāyī, upahaccaparinibbāyī, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī, uddhaṃsoto akaniṭṭhagāmīti pañcadhā.
segments.vism23:888.4: Tattha antarāparinibbāyīti yattha katthaci suddhāvāsabhave upapajjitvā āyuvemajjhaṃ appatvāva parinibbāyati.
segments.vism23:888.8: Uddhaṃsoto akaniṭṭhagāmīti yatthupapanno, tato uddhaṃ yāva akaniṭṭhabhavā āruyha tattha parinibbāyati.
segments.vism23:889.1: Catutthamaggapaññaṃ bhāvetvā koci saddhāvimutto hoti, koci paññāvimutto hoti, koci ubhatobhāgavimutto hoti, koci tevijjo, koci chaḷabhiñño, koci paṭisambhidappabhedappatto mahākhīṇāsavo.
segments.vism23:889.2: Yaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ ‘‘maggakkhaṇe panesa taṃ jaṭaṃ vijaṭeti nāma.
segments.vism23:889.3: Phalakkhaṇe vijaṭitajaṭo sadevakassa lokassa aggadakkhiṇeyyo hotī’’ti.
segments.vism23:889.5: Yasmā tasmā kareyyātha, ratiṃ tattha vicakkhaṇo.
segments.vism23:890.2: Sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño, cittaṃ paññañca bhāvayaṃ;
segments.vism23:890.3: Ātāpī nipako bhikkhu, so imaṃ vijaṭaye jaṭanti. –
segments.vism23:890.4: Imissā gāthāya sīlasamādhipaññāmukhena desite visuddhimagge sānisaṃsā paññābhāvanā paridīpitā hotīti.
segments.vism23:891.2: ‘‘Sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño, cittaṃ paññañca bhāvayaṃ;
segments.vism23:891.3: Ātāpī nipako bhikkhu, so imaṃ vijaṭaye jaṭa’’nti. –
segments.vism23:894.1: Visuddhimaggo eso ca, antarāyaṃ vinā idha;
segments.vism23:895.1: Parama visuddha saddhā buddhi vīriya paṭimaṇḍitena sīlācārajjava maddavādiguṇasamudayasamuditena sakasamaya samayantaragahanajjhogāhaṇasamatthena paññāveyyattiyasamannāgatena tipiṭakapariyattibhede sāṭṭhakathe satthusāsane appaṭihatañāṇappabhāvena mahāveyyākaraṇena karaṇasampattijanitasukhaviniggatamadhurodāravacanalāvaṇṇayuttena yuttamuttavādinā vādīvarena mahākavinā chaḷabhiññāpaṭisambhidādi bhedaguṇapaṭimaṇḍite uttarimanussadhamme appaṭihatabuddhīnaṃ theravaṃsappadīpānaṃ therānaṃ mahāvihāravāsīnaṃ vaṃsālaṅkārabhūtena vipulavisuddhabuddhinā buddhaghosoti garūhi gahitanāmadheyyena therena mudantakhedakavattabbena kato visuddhimaggo nāma.
